E0003

Expected a current statement form, found an unsupported or incomplete form

What

Expected a current statement form, found an unsupported or incomplete form

Why

This position accepts only a complete statement from Jet's current grammar

Fix

Write the complete statement form named by the diagnostic

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0003: tests/ui/bare_error_mark_is_not_a_contract.stderr.

Error [jet.InvalidStatement]: A unit-fallible signature has no `->`
  --> tests/ui/bare_error_mark_is_not_a_contract.jet:4:27
    |
  4 | bare: fn(text: String) -> Int ! {
    |                           ^^^^^
 Why: A function that can fail but returns no value has no result payload for an arrow to introduce
 Fix: Write `save: fn(path: String) IOError!`, or omit the contract for implicit `Err`
